title: XLQA: A Benchmark for Locale-Aware Multilingual Open-Domain Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (Exact Match and F1 scores) on a custom benchmark (XLQA) that categorizes questions into locale-invariant and locale-sensitive subsets to measure models' deficits in regionally and culturally grounded knowledge.

Comparing question answering accuracy across eight different languages (English, Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese, Russian, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Vietnamese) to expose English-centric performance gaps and evaluate disparities in linguistic competence.
